hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)}" || exit 0; [ -f context/project.yml ] && [ -f apm.lock.yaml ] || exit 0; r=$(git rev-parse --git-path agent-harness/apm-lock 2>/dev/null); s=$(cksum < apm.lock.yaml); if ! (sed -n 's/^ *- \(\.[^ :]*\)$/\1/p' apm.lock.yaml | while read -r p; do [ -e "$p" ] || exit 1; done) || { [ -n "$r" ] && [ "$(cat "$r" 2>/dev/null)" != "$s" ]; }; then if command -v apm >/dev/null; then apm install --frozen >&2 || exit 1; [ -z "$r" ] || { mkdir -p "$(dirname "$r")" && printf '%s\n' "$s" > "$r"; }; else echo "agent-harness: apm がないので、apm.lock.yaml に配置先をそろえられない" >&2; fi; fi; d=$(ls -d .claude/skills/setup-agent-harness .agents/skills/setup-agent-harness ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:+"$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/skills/setup-agent-harness"} 2>/dev/null | head -1); [ -z "$d" ] || node "$d/scripts/setup.mjs" --gitignore >&2

f="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/core/hooks/check-comments.mjs"; [ -f "$f" ] || f="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/$f"; [ -f "$f" ] || { t=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$t" ] && [ -f "$t/context/project.yml" ] && echo "agent-harness: check-comments.mjs がないので、コメントのチェックを飛ばした。apm install --frozen で配置する" >&2; exit 0; }; node "$f"

f="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/docs/hooks/check-docs.mjs"; [ -f "$f" ] || f="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/$f"; [ -f "$f" ] || { t=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$t" ] && [ -f "$t/context/project.yml" ] && echo "agent-harness: check-docs.mjs がないので、文書のチェックを飛ばした。apm install --frozen で配置する" >&2; exit 0; }; node "$f"
